messages:
Sophia: Quick sync — GranitePay POC cutover target 2025-02-14. Need infra signoff (VPN + firewall), SE smoke tests, and CR approvals for the model-routing change. Owners please confirm who takes what.
Arjun: I'll own VPN + firewall. Two quick q's: do we require static IPs from them, and will the VPN be site-to-site or client-based? @Lena can you confirm their network type?
Lena: Customer said site-to-site is preferred. They can open a maintenance window 2025-02-13 22:00–02:00 UTC for cutover testing. Contact=raj@granitepay.com; will share VPN creds by 2025-02-12.
Mike: Platform will reserve a Dedicated slot for the test window. FYI staging has seen intermittent 503s on the model proxy — PR linked below is intended to fix routing fallbacks. I'll need CRs on that before we merge. <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/482>
Arjun: I'll review PR #482 today. Also ensure firewall allows `50051` and `443` from GranitePay's ASN. Suggested iptables snippet for the edge box:
```
# allow gpay ASN ranges (example)
-A INPUT -p tcp -m multiport --dports 443,50051 -s 203.0.113.0/24 -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```
Olivia: I'll run SE smoke tests during the window. My checklist: auth handshake ✅, model routing -> `v2` variant, p50 latency <300ms, embeddings sanity check. Need a small sample dataset and a read-only API key. Can Sales attach dataset to this thread?
Sophia: Sending a scrubbed sample now (S3 link) and a read-only key via secure DM. Success criteria we agreed on: E2E pass 5/5, error rate <1% over 1h, no >3 consecutive token failures in routing.
deploy-bot: scheduled: staging-maintenance starting 2025-02-13T21:30Z duration 02:00 (staging cluster will be temporarily unavailable).
Mike: Noted. I'll hold the merge until Arjun + Olivia give thumbs up. I also want to capture the intermittent 503s logs — adding a brief log snippet in the PR.
Arjun: Left one comment on backoff/retry in the PR, small change. If the change is applied I can +1 and merge.
Mike: Acked — will patch per comment and re-run staging smoke.
Olivia: If you can get the PR merged by EOD 2025-02-12 I can run the full SE E2E on 2025-02-13 during the maintenance window. Otherwise we risk slipping the cutover.
Sophia: Team, please flag any blockers by EOD tomorrow. If all green we'll proceed with cutover on 2025-02-14 morning for the customer.
Lena: Confirmed — GranitePay will share VPN credentials and a network contact by 2025-02-12 EOD. :thumbsup:
Sophia: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
